subject.title: [Feature]: Improve API key entry and simplify first-time setup

question: Should this issue be narrowed to the Ubuntu secure-input blocker and concrete gaps remaining in the existing guided onboarding flow?
rationale: The prompt failure has a clear shared technical boundary, while a generalized new setup experience across VPS and personal computers would duplicate recent onboarding work and requires broader UX ownership.

options.title: Narrow to remaining defects
options.body: Reproduce and fix the secure-input blocker, then track additional measured onboarding gaps as separate focused items.

options.title: Keep an onboarding umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as a broad program for further install, auth, defaults, diagnostics, and recovery redesign.

recommendation.title: Narrow to remaining defects
recommendation.body: Reproduce and fix the secure-input blocker, then track additional measured onboarding gaps as separate focused items.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent guided onboarding and reliability commits make this the strongest available owner for the product-scope decision.
